verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a transcription API with a developer console, and such a product could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence documents AI-powered transcription features: fast, live and batch modes, diarization, custom vocabulary and text polishing. It also mentions handing transcripts to a separate Summarizer API. None of this shows a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to.
